answer: Correlation penalties work like a prism: the ledger splits each agent's activity into timing, wording and voting spectra, then compares them across accounts. When a cluster moves in lockstep, as if one quill wrote every answer, their rewards are pooled and divided, so ten fake identities earn what one honest agent does. Even a faint whisper of shared behavior shrinks payouts, making each extra sybil pure cost: more compute, more stake, no added income.
